THE OBSERVATION, operator 2026-09-14, live on smartsite.cloud in an INCOGNITO window at `?via=empressa`. Collapsed brief shows land use, lot, flood plus a 'Sign in to unlock deep research' panel. Clicking 'More facts' then reveals the FULL brief with no authentication: APN, county, year built, ZONING (MU), SETBACKS (F 15 / S 5 / R 15), buildable, special district, pipeline, well, footprint, boundary, city limits, WHO SERVES, school district, utility service, overlay districts, agValuation and maxImperviousCover. Operator intent: the brief should require sign-in.

TWO GATES ARE VISIBLE AND ONLY ONE FIRES. Owner and tax-assessed value ARE gated ('Owner data is on Studio. Upgrade to see who owns this parcel'). The sign-in gate fires only on the deep-research TOOL, not on the brief. So gating machinery exists and works. The question is why it covers exactly two fields and not the rest — answer that before designing anything.

HYPOTHESIS 1, cheapest to test, check it first. The observed URL carries `?via=empressa`, a PromoteKit affiliate param, and p185 deployed PromoteKit to BOTH the PE site and cortex-api on 2026-09-14. Does the affiliate path relax or bypass the gate? One A/B: incognito load with `?via=empressa` versus a bare incognito load. If behaviour differs, this is a fresh regression from today's deploy and not a standing tier question.

HYPOTHESIS 2, the structural one. `accessPolicy` gates a WHOLE ATOM, never a field. If the zoning, setback and who-serves atoms carry `public-free`, the surface is correctly serving what policy says and THE FIX IS UPSTREAM IN THE POLICY, not in the UI. Adding a UI gate over a public-free atom leaves every other consumer — MCP catalog tools return bodies whole with no field strip by design — still serving it. Check the atom policy before touching the surface.
HYPOTHESIS 3. The free tier is intentionally this wide and the operator is changing the intent. That is a tier ruling, not a defect, and it belongs to pricing rather than to a repair lane.

PROPORTION, state it rather than assume it. Texas property records are public and the brief already serves owner free from `cad_property` elsewhere, so this class is usually PAID-TIER INTEGRITY rather than a privacy breach. Say which one this is in the close. It changes the urgency and it changes who owns the fix.
DO NOT FIX BY ADDING A STRIPPER. Protection that lives downstream of the policy only covers the consumers that implement it. If a field must be gated, move it to a correctly-policied atom.
